note: Compiled from BADAN_MASTER_BLUEPRINT.md by scripts/mine-blueprint workflow. Source of truth for the app registry. (§20/56 Export subsystem)

csvColumns.name: record_id
csvColumns.description: Stable per-record identifier, unchanged across re-exports; dedup lineage target.

csvColumns.name: record_kind
csvColumns.description: Record shape: sample | interval | session | event | derived | baseline (instant vs aggregate vs typed-event vs computed).

csvColumns.name: metric_id
csvColumns.description: Registry metric id (e.g. vitals.hrv_rmssd); language-stable join key.

csvColumns.name: metric_display
csvColumns.description: Localized display name of the metric in the export's display_language.

csvColumns.name: value
csvColumns.description: Recorded value in the active unit profile (canonical unless a display/custom unit profile overrides).

csvColumns.name: unit
csvColumns.description: UCUM-style unit token for value, from the metric registry.

csvColumns.name: canonical_value
csvColumns.description: Same measurement in the metric's canonical unit, independent of unit profile — raw provenance anchor.

csvColumns.name: canonical_unit
csvColumns.description: Canonical UCUM unit token paired with canonical_value.

csvColumns.name: value_type
csvColumns.description: raw | derived | aggregate — separates measured rows from computed/rolled-up rows.

csvColumns.name: is_derived
csvColumns.description: True when the row is engine-computed (score/baseline); false for measured/raw — explicit raw-vs-derived flag.

csvColumns.name: timestamp_start
csvColumns.description: Measured-at start instant (offset carried, not normalized).

csvColumns.name: timestamp_end
csvColumns.description: Interval/session end; null for instant samples.

csvColumns.name: timezone
csvColumns.description: Timezone at measurement; basis for day-boundary computation (§30.1 provenance).

csvColumns.name: recorded_at
csvColumns.description: Ingestion timestamp; retro/backdated logging detectable by divergence from timestamp_start.

csvColumns.name: source_app
csvColumns.description: Bundle/package id of the app that produced the record.

csvColumns.name: source_device
csvColumns.description: Capturing device model + name.

csvColumns.name: ingestion_path
csvColumns.description: platform | vendor_direct | broker | import | manual — how the record entered BADAN.

csvColumns.name: source_external_id
csvColumns.description: Upstream system's own id for the record; source-lineage and dedup correlation key.

csvColumns.name: import_batch_id
csvColumns.description: One-tap-undo import lineage id (§30.5).

csvColumns.name: quality_flags
csvColumns.description: Semicolon-delimited quality flags (e.g. artifact_suspect;low_coverage).

csvColumns.name: confidence
csvColumns.description: Per-record confidence score when the metric defines one.

csvColumns.name: algorithm_id
csvColumns.description: Algorithm id on derived rows; keys the manifest methodology link.

csvColumns.name: algorithm_version
csvColumns.description: Version of the algorithm on derived rows; enables reproducibility across schema majors.

csvColumns.name: suppressed_by
csvColumns.description: record_id of the winning record when this row was dedup-suppressed; present only when scope includes suppressed duplicates.

manifestFields: export_id (ULID) — names the artifact and echoes into every file
export_schema_version (semver, per-format) — the schemaVersion; frozen contract with changelog
scope (serialized ExportScope) — full scope echo; export is reproducible from its manifest
date_range (closed-open, per timezone_policy) — the exported period
unit_profile (string) — unit choices applied to value/unit columns (canonical | display | custom)
display_language (BCP-47) — language of the metric_display / *_display columns
timezone_policy (string) — 'timestamps carry original offsets; day boundaries computed in tz-at-measurement' + notes
dedup_policy (string) — policy description + version, and whether suppressed rows are included
per_metric_row_counts (map metric_id → count) — makes truncation detectable
methodology_links (map algorithm_id → public methodology URL) — for every derived metric present
checksums (map file → sha256) — canonical-serialization integrity per file
data_quality_note (string) — coverage-gap summary for the period
notes: Raw and derived are physically separated, never merged into shared columns: ExportScope.payloadKinds {RAW, DERIVED} are 'separated in output, never merged columns' — CSV routes measured rows to per-metric-family files (sleep.csv, vitals.csv) and computed scores/baselines to derived.csv, and every row is tagged with value_type + is_derived. (Column authority: §20.2's full contract governs; §56.2's CsvWriter parenthetical lists only an abbreviated subset — the fuller §20.2/§20.5 set is the frozen contract.)

Canonical value survives unit-profile changes: canonical_value/canonical_unit always carry the metric's canonical unit regardless of the display/custom unit profile applied to value/unit, so raw provenance is preserved and conversions (mmol/L vs mg/dL) live only in ExportMapping — impossible-by-construction unit errors, tested per-locale.

Derived rows are self-documenting and auditable: algorithm_id + algorithm_version on each derived row key into manifest.methodology_links (and the JSON bundle's derived_values[] carry input_manifest refs to their contributing inputs), so every computed value traces back to method + version + inputs and is never presented as if it were raw.

Suppressed duplicates are excluded by default and opt-in only, as lineage not deletion: ExportScope.includeSuppressedDuplicates defaults false; when included, each suppressed row keeps suppressed_by = winning record_id (chain preserved), manifest.dedup_policy records the policy/version and inclusion state, and the on/off row-count delta equals exactly the count of suppressed_by IS NOT NULL rows.

Provenance is complete and row-level: every row carries source_app, source_device, ingestion_path, source_external_id, import_batch_id, recorded_at and timezone so the source chain → dedup decision is fully reconstructable, while manifest per_metric_row_counts + checksums make truncation and tampering detectable.
